review_candidates.title: Chief Financial Officer
review_candidates.description: Hubble Network was founded with the intention of delivering on the promise of what Internet-of-Things (IoT) was supposed to be. We're building a global Bluetooth® network dedicated to machine-to-machine connectivity. We differentiate ourselves as the first modem-less and gateway-less, direct-to-satellite network from off-the-shelf Bluetooth® Low Energy chips. Hubble is ideal for applications in logistics, AgTech, and maritime where economies of scale for volume consumer and enterprise asset tracking is a priority. Our goal is to be the first billion-endpoint-connected network in the world. Hubble is an early-stage, venture-backed startup supported by some of the best investors in the world. In their previous lives, the founding team has been successful in raising $100s of millions in venture funding, developing the Amazon Sidewalk network, launching billions of dollars of space assets, and leading their teams to successful exits, both through acquisition and IPO. We are now looking to bring on talented team members who are the best at what they do to help us make Hubble a reality for the world. This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco, CA About the Role We are looking for a Chief Financial Officer (CFO) who wants to be a builder. The CFO will strengthen the financial infrastructure behind Hubble Network and help leadership evaluate the strategic paths available to a capital-efficient private company, including continued independent growth, future private investment, strategic transactions, and eventual public-company readiness. This is a hands-on executive role for a finance leader who can operate at both the strategic and operational levels. You will work directly with the COO and leadership team to build the systems, reporting, controls, planning discipline, and capital strategy that Hubble Network needs as it scales. You will own finance, accounting, and FP&A, improve decision quality across the company, and help prepare Hubble Network for the opportunities available to a profitable private technology company. The current finance function is lean. A small team is already in place, and the CFO will be expected to lead, mentor, and level up that team while also building better systems and processes. Some processes need to be formalized. Some systems need to be established or upgraded. Some reporting needs to become more sophisticated and automated. We want someone who sees that as an opportunity. The right person will bring structure, judgment, and rigor without adding bureaucracy. Responsibilities: Own accounting, finance, budgeting, forecasting, tax, reporting, and strategic finance functions, including management of a small finance and accounting team. Build scalable financial systems, reporting processes, and internal controls for a profitable, growing technology company. Lead budgeting, forecasting, cash planning, financial modeling, and performance reporting. Partner with the COO and leadership team on capital allocation, pricing, margins, hiring plans, vendor spend, accounts receivable, legal spend, and long-term strategy. Advise on long-term capital strategy, including continued independent growth, future private investment, debt or equity financing, strategic partnerships, M&A, and eventual public-company readiness. Build the financial reporting, controls, forecasting, and diligence readiness needed to keep those strategic paths available. Prepare clear financial materials for leadership, investors, lenders, auditors, advisors, and strategic counterparties when needed. Manage tax planning, tax reporting, franchise tax filings, and relationships with outside tax advisors. Lead month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close processes. Lead, mentor, and develop the finance and accounting team while building clearer processes, stronger reporting, and a better operating cadence. Improve the finance function while preserving Hubble Network's high-trust, transparent, and low-bureaucracy culture. Required Skills: 7+ years as a CFO, VP of Finance, Controller, Head of Finance (FP&A), investment banker, strategic finance leader, or capital markets professional. Experience with public or private investment, including investor relations, equity or debt financing, M&A, growth equity, venture capital, private capital, or IPO/public-company readiness. Strong understanding of financial reporting, accounting operations, tax, budgeting, forecasting, internal controls, and audit readiness. Experience in high-growth technology, SaaS, API, AI, data infrastructure, developer tools, or usage-based business models. Ability to turn financial data into clear recommendations for founders and operators. Strong judgment, high ownership, and comfort building inside a lean company. Willingness to do both strategic executive work and hands-on operating work. Clear written communication and strong async collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications: CPA, MBA, public accounting, investment banking, transaction advisory, or strategic finance background. Experience preparing a private company for institutional investment, M&A, audit, IPO readiness, or public-company reporting. Experience with finance systems, ERP implementation, SaaS metrics, usage-based revenue models, 409A valuations, equity administration, board reporting, or investor materials. Experience working directly with founders, technical teams, or engineering-led companies. Compensation & Benefits: 💰 Salary: $250,000-$350,000 annually (commensurate with experience) 🩺 Comprehensive Benefits – Health, Dental, Vision, & HSA options 🌍 Unlimited PTO 🚇 Commuter Benefits (if working from HQ) 🎓 Learning & Development Allowance 💪 Health & Wellness Stipend 🌎 Sabbatical Program – Recharge and explore new ideas 🛠 Cutting-Edge Space Tech – Work on state-of-the-art satellite system The posted compensation range reflects multiple levels within Hubble Network's Talent architecture. Final level placement and corresponding compensation will be determined through the interview and assessment process, taking into consideration factors such as the candidate's relevant experience, qualifications, skills, and geographical location. ITAR REQUIREMENTS Hubble is required by the U.S. Government to comply with various space technology export regulations including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). All applicants must be U.S. citizens or lawful permanent residents ("green card holders") as defined by ITAR (22 CFR 120.15). More information on ITAR can be found here. Hubble is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. Each individual has the right to work in a professional environment that promotes equal employment opportunity and prohibits discriminatory practices, including harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Seattle Washington Washington Pay $250,000—$350,000 USD

L’organisation développe plusieurs programmes dans les pays où elle déploie ses activités, notamment : les villages d’enfants, les centres pour jeunes, les programmes d’appui à la famille, des écoles, des crèches, des centres d’apprentissage et des centres de santé mère-enfant. SOS Villages d’Enfants est implantée en République de Guinée depuis 1985 et dépend administrativement du Bureau International Région Afrique de l’Ouest et du Centre basé à Dakar. Dans Le Cadre De L’intensification Des Ses Échanges Avec Ses Donateurs Internationaux, Le Bureau National SOS Villages D’Enfants–Guinée, à Conakry, Recherche Un(e) Professionnel(le) Motivé(e) Et Dynamique Pour Pourvoir Au Poste De Voir plus Nouvelles Guinée Actualités Guinée Informations régionales Titre Du Poste Coordinateur (trice) National(e) de Parrainages Internationaux Mission Le/la Coordinateur(trice) National(e) de Parrainages Internationaux travaille sous la supervision du Directeur National. L’intéressé(e) s’assure que les parrains internationaux bénéficient de services d’un haut niveau de qualité : rapports, requêtes, visites, correspondances, management des dons, etc. Il/elle se charge en outre du suivi-évaluation des objectifs dévolus au service ; l’implémentation des directives internationales ; l’organisation et la réalisation des tâches de parrainage au sein des villages d’enfants. Profil, Aptitudes Et Qualifications Etre de nationalité guinéenne Etre titulaire d’une Licence en Communication, Marketing, Journalisme, Langues ou toute autre discipline affinitaire ; Avoir une bonne maîtrise de l’Anglais aussi bien parlé qu’écrit (vos compétences en langue anglaise feront l’objet d’un test) ; Avoir une expérience de 2-3 ans les domaines de la communication et/ou de la rédaction; Avoir une bonne connaissance des us et coutumes locales de la Guinée ; Avoir une ouverture d’esprit et être attentif aux détails ; Etre sociable, consciencieux et intègre ; Maîtriser l’outil informatique (Suite MS Office : Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook et Internet) et la gestion des bases de données ; Une expérience dans le domaine du parrainage ou du plaidoyer est un atout. NB : Les candidat(e)s doivent adresser au Directeur National de SOS Village d’Enfants Guinée : une lettre de motivation, un curriculum vitae, une copie des diplômes et des attestations des expériences dans les domaines couverts par le poste (stages, formations etc.), la liste de trois personnes de référence et leur adresse complète. Les dossiers susmentionnés devront être envoyés aux adresses électroniques suivantes : Humaines@sosguinea.org et sos-no@sosguinea.org avec en objet la mention : Candidature au poste SOS /CNPI /2016 La date limite de réception des dossiers est fixée au 03/10/2016 ; seul(e)s les candidat(e)s retenu(e)s seront contacté(e)s. SOS Villages d’Enfants Guinée se réserve le droit de procéder à la vérification du casier judiciaire et de demander les copies certifiées conformes des diplômes/certificats pour les candidatures retenues.
